why: Runs the ToonForge CLI, MCP server, and scheduler.
disk: Application install is typically under 200 MB plus user media.

install.darwin: Install Node.js 22 from https://nodejs.org/ or Homebrew (brew install node@22). ToonForge does not run an unpinned install script.
install.linux: Install Node.js 22 from your distribution or https://nodejs.org/. ToonForge does not pipe a remote shell script.

why: Builds and validates short test media, captions muxing, and thumbnails.
license: GPL/LGPL build-dependent. Install the official FFmpeg package for your OS; ToonForge does not vendor FFmpeg.

install.linux: Use your distro package (for example apt install ffmpeg). Root may be required for the system package manager.
install.win32: Install FFmpeg from https://ffmpeg.org/download.html and add it to PATH.

why: Validates container, codec, duration, and streams before any publish gate.

install.win32: Installed with FFmpeg. Confirm ffprobe.exe is on PATH.

install.win32: Install Python 3.10+ from https://www.python.org/downloads/ and enable the py launcher if you use it.
